Team — passing ownership for Aegis activation. Summary below and a few open constraints. Please read and reply with confirmations.

Deal snapshot (short):
- Account: Aegis Health — enterprise, multi-region (US).
- Committed Dedicated capacity: 4 GPUs reserved (q4 ramp).
- Billing: net 12 months, start on go-live.
- Contract: MSA signed (DocuSign link in thread).

Customer asks / constraints:
- Security pack: SOC 2 Type II requested + encryption-at-rest AES-256; customer expects evidence by kickoff.
- SSO: Okta-based SAML; customer will provide IdP metadata 72h before kickoff.
- Data residency: US-only, region us-west-2 preferred.
- Maintenance window: tentative switch 2026-11-18 00:00–04:00 PT (customer-controlled).
- Expected peak QPS during pilot: ~220 requests/min, 95th latency SLO 300ms.

Primary CS owner: @karthik_iyer (please confirm).
Implementation lead (ops/staging): @tessa_morgan (please confirm scheduling for preflight).
Billing and post-sign ops contact: @monica_patel.

Attachments: signed_MSA.pdf (attached by customer), draft kickoff agenda (aegis_kickoff-agenda.docx).

Immediate next steps: 
1) Karthik — confirm you own the activation and that the dedicated pool size looks right and unblocked by infra.
2) Tessa — propose two kickoff slots Wed/Thu next week AM PT; include preflight checklist link.
3) Monica — confirm billing start date logic and whether any PO needed before go-live.
4) I will coordinate InfoSec artifact delivery with the customer and pull SOC2 evidence from Security.

Thanks — keeping this concise so we can get a time on calendar and handover cleanly.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
